cases.input: Design a new landing page in a repository with confirmed PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md.
requiredBehaviors: respect PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md as authoritative
route a new surface to frontend-design-shaping
pass personal defaults only as overridable hypotheses
forbiddenBehaviors: replace project rules with personal defaults
skip project context because the requested style seems obvious

cases.input: The user likes a visual direction in one project and asks for another feature elsewhere.
requiredBehaviors: keep a one-off project choice project-scoped
only send repeated or explicitly durable preferences to communication-memory-governance
preserve the authority hierarchy
forbiddenBehaviors: promote a single project choice to global taste
let Impeccable heuristics override confirmed project decisions

cases.input: A design request arrives without confirmed PRODUCT.md or DESIGN.md and the agent wants to start coding.
requiredBehaviors: route first to frontend-product-context
route next to frontend-design-system-context
reject skipping the required grillings
forbiddenBehaviors: infer authoritative product and design context from repository evidence alone
skillAnchors: ersetzt aber niemals das jeweils erforderliche Grilling

cases.input: PRODUCT.md is confirmed. DESIGN.md defines colors, typography and spacing, but says nothing about logo/favicon coherence, app icon, project-specific copy or how the key visual represents the project's core properties. The user asks to build a new feature.
requiredBehaviors: treat the existing DESIGN.md as incomplete
route back to frontend-design-system-context before shaping
include the failed Brand-and-Context/Acceptance Gate in the handoff
forbiddenBehaviors: assume visual polish makes the incomplete DESIGN.md authoritative enough
fill missing design-system rules during feature implementation
skillAnchors: Ein vorhandenes `DESIGN.md` gilt nur dann als vollständig
Fehlt ein anwendbarer Punkt, route vor Shaping/Polish zurück zu `frontend-design-system-context`

cases.input: PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md are otherwise complete for an installable app, but DESIGN.md has a logo and favicon only and never defines an app icon.
requiredBehaviors: identify the app icon as a failed applicable acceptance-gate requirement
route to frontend-design-system-context
do not proceed to implementation until the app icon rule is resolved
forbiddenBehaviors: treat app icon as optional for an app
route to shaping despite the failed gate

cases.input: DESIGN.md calls for a clean modern SaaS look, blue-purple gradient, generic AI copy and an abstract decorative hero, without project-specific rationale or visual mapping. The user asks for polish.
requiredBehaviors: reject the design context as incomplete despite its polished aesthetic
route back to frontend-design-system-context before polish
identify color copy and key-visual context gaps
forbiddenBehaviors: route directly to frontend-design-review for surface polish
accept generic SaaS AI defaults as a valid project design system
skillAnchors: Key Visual, das mindestens zwei der priorisierten 2–3 Projekteigenschaften grafisch transportiert

cases.input: PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md are confirmed. DESIGN.md defines a project-specific logo, matching favicon and app icon, contextual colors, domain-specific copy and a key visual mapping three project properties. The user asks to audit the implemented app.
requiredBehaviors: recognize the Brand-and-Context Gate as complete
route the audit to frontend-design-review
include gate status in the handoff
forbiddenBehaviors: re-route to frontend-design-system-context without evidence of a gap

cases.input: PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md are confirmed and pass all brand-and-context requirements. The user asks for a new settings surface consistent with the existing app.
requiredBehaviors: recognize the acceptance gate as complete
route the new surface to frontend-design-shaping
carry the existing branding copy color and key-visual rules as authoritative context
forbiddenBehaviors: re-grill already confirmed design rules without a material conflict
invent new branding for the settings surface
